self_harm_or_suicide.when: intent, attempt, active plan, current means, or inability to stay safe

violence.when: credible intent to seriously harm another person

overdose_or_poisoning.when: suspected or confirmed overdose, poisoning, or dangerous ingestion

medical_emergency.when: severe breathing difficulty, loss of consciousness, seizure, stroke-like symptoms, severe allergic reaction, severe chest pressure, uncontrolled major bleeding, or other clear emergency

psychosis_or_mania.when: new/worsening hallucinations, paranoia, disorganization, extreme sleep loss, dangerous impulsivity, command experiences, or impaired reality testing; immediate if danger is present

medication_question.when: questions about stopping, starting, tapering, side effects, missed doses, or dosing; defer medication changes to prescriber/pharmacist and written plan
